It has been evaluated and compared to the most relevant literature to highlight the strengths and weaknesses of various strategies. Finally, the prediction of Claustrophobia will be incorporated.

articleTitle: Interference-Aware Channel Allocation using Cournot Game Comparing with Potential Game Algorithm to Maximize the Transmission Data Rate of Secondary Users in Cognitive radio Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The objective of the proposed study is to improve the transmission data rate during interference-aware channel allocation for secondary users by substituting the Novel Cournot Game for other game algorithms. Resources and techniques Potential algorithms are compared, and the Novel Cournot game algorithm is suggested. The sample size was calculated using G power (80%), which resulted in 20 samples (N = 10 each). There is a statistically significant difference of 0.014 between the two groups (p 0.05). The mean transmission data rate of the Cournot game is 0.3520, which is significantly higher than the mean data rate of the potential game, which is 0.2460. The Novel Cournot Game outperforms the prospective game in terms of InterferenceAware Channel Allocation for Secondary transmission data rate.

articleTitle: An Efficient Sensory Monitoring & Bacteria Detection System for Contaminated Water
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a technological innovation that makes it easier for smart devices to communicate with one another and requires less human intervention.Internet of Things is a booming concept in all the fields thus we applied to our sensory system of wastewater monitoring too. Machine learning, a neo-modern technology and a subset of AI makes lives easier by solving day-to-day problems. Smart sensory system can be used for monitoring the wastewater mixing with the potable water supplied by the corporation to prevent humans from getting affected by their obnoxiousness. The detection mechanism using machine learning and deep learning can be used to identify and classify the illness causing pathogens in a shorter span of time.

articleTitle: A Rule based Modified Quadratic Mean for the Elimination of Outliers in Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: A Rule based Modified Quadratic Mean based for the Elimination of Outliers in Natural Images is proposed. The algorithm employs series of decision that checks for fixed valued outliers and noisy information about the vicinity that is being processed. The Experimental results suggests that the Modified quadratic Mean fairs well when compared to existing algorithms and Conventional Quadratic Mean. The Algorithm restored the image by keeping the information intact.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Cancer Data Sets Utilizing Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: This research aims to ensure precision in medical outcomes by comparing and contrasting classification approaches using various (Lucamia) cancer knowledge sets using data processing technologies. Many researchers have investigated this question, and their findings have lent credence to using specialised knowledge bases and classifiers. They have compared and contrasted various knowledge sets, including those found online. Here, we compare the results of a neural network classification with those obtained without one.

articleTitle: Improve Students reading skills via the use of computer-assisted reading programmes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Concerns have been raised about whether or not technology-assisted reading programs are effective in helping young students improve their reading abilities. This article presents the results of a seven-month research that aimed to answer the question of whether or not computer-assisted reading programs should be widely adopted by pupils in grades eight through ten in secondary schools. Besides the obvious gain in reading ability,have considered other potential advantages of such an intervention. This report provides a qualitative analysis of the positive and negative outcomes for students who took part in the electronic reading program. Learners and educators were interviewed to compile the qualitative data. Students' progress in reading-related areas (such as fluency, comprehension, spelling, and language) was continuously monitored in order to determine the reading program's success. When the program was put into place, the students' reading scores were compared to those from the pre-program evaluation. Students' engagement in the reading campaign contributed to their overall assessment of the program's success.This study makes an effort to shed light on the significance of modifying instructional strategies in the wake of a crisis, as well as the benefits and drawbacks of using computers to aid in the reading comprehension of secondary school students.

articleTitle: An Innovative Method for Encrypting Pictures without a Key
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: In order to circumvent the constraints imposed by picture size and key records, as well as the prohibitive computing costs associated with key-oriented strategies, several researchers have turned to brute-force assaults. This study proposes a better keyless method of encrypting lossless RGB photos. For the purpose of picture encryption, two methods are in use: image splitting and multiple sharing. By scattering the pixel bit randomly over the picture, we hope to improve the degree of security. SST is also a great way to increase storage space. For this keyless method, we'll use reversible encryption to protect the original file without sacrificing quality.

articleTitle: Application of Waning Immunity Index Model using Spiking Neural Networks for COVID-19 Pandemic in the geographic context of India
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNN) are biologically inspired networks working on the principle of communication triggered while crossing of threshold potentials. During the COVID-19 pandemic, immunity has been acquired by the population in a geographical location by infections and immunizations. The Waning Immunity Model (WII) has been used to apply the method of SNNs so that the results of the model provide a better way of understanding its effects. The dataset considered in this research is for a time period of six months during the years of 2021 and 2022 focusing on the geographical location of India. Based on the proposed new model, the spike in the WII index is clearly evident in the first half of the time period under consideration, This model will help the healthcare and governments officials to plan for the booster doses to be administered to the human population for reinvigorating the antibodies effectively fighting the COVID-19 virus.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework for Building Vulnerability Assessment for the 2015 Nepal Earthquake
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: On April 25, 2015, a devastating earthquake of magnitude Mw 7.8 hit Nepal, killing around 9000 people and injuring 22000 more. Following the disaster, extensive field research and inspections were conducted in Nepal to determine the extent of damage to the earthquake-affected structures. The post-earthquake investigation procedure becomes extremely difficult due to the vast number of structures and types of buildings in the area. However, knowing a building’s description beforehand can assist in determining the extent of possible damages due to a large event. In light of this, the present study aims to provide an effective formulation for building vulnerability assessment using several parameters, such as number of floors, construction materials, house type (public or private), and age of building. A huge dataset comprising building information of around 3,50,000 buildings on 39 variables is used for this purpose. Six machine learning methods, namely logistic regression, decision-tree classifier, k-nearest neighbor, linear discriminant analysis, random forest, and extreme gradient boosting algorithms are implemented. Based on the score, the grading boosting algorithm is found to be the most suitable algorithm. The findings are helpful for better urban planning, social policymaking, suitable material identification for building construction, and moreover, to set up a national level disaster risk reduction (DRR) strategy to minimize earthquake losses in Nepal..

articleTitle: An Outsourced Access Management System for Secure and Verifiable Fog-Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: In this study, we provide HPCS, a clinical decision support system architecture that utilises a mixture of public and private cloud resources. A fog server in "HPCS" employs a minimal data mining technique to keep constant, secure tabs on a patient's health status. Once abnormal symptoms have been discovered, they may be safely sent to a server in the cloud, where they can be predicted with great accuracy. We create a unique secure outsourced inner-product protocol to produce a one-layer neural network on fog servers securely. Any activation function in a multilayer neural network may be safely implemented on a cloud server without compromising the user's privacy using a piecewise polynomial computing technique. One unique protocol, the "privacy-preserving fraction approximation protocol," is aimed at solving the problem of computational overload. We use simulations to demonstrate that the "HPCS" strikes an ideal balance between real-time and highly accurate prediction, therefore achieving the aim of monitoring the health state of patients without compromising their privacy to other parties.

articleTitle: A Robust Breast Cancer Classification Model using Extra-Trees Classifier for Histopathological Image
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Thousands of people die every quarter from breast cancer. Diagnosis and treatment at an early stage can drastically lower mortality rates. Traditional manual diagnosis, on the other hand, necessitates a large amount of labor by pathologists and is prone to diagnostic mistakes the longer they work. Rapid and accurate diagnosis are greatly aided by automatic histopathological image recognition. The biomedical industry has been drawn to Artificial Intelligence and its innovative methodologies because of its familiarity with the field's successes. Recent research has shown that AI can grasp details better than humans, leading to more accurate findings that aid professionals in making more informed judgments. This study presents the Extra-Tree classifier (ETC) for breast cancer image categorization. These findings demonstrate that ETC outperformed the other algorithms we examined for this data in terms of accuracy. Future researchers in the field of breast cancer will be able to use the findings of this study to guide their investigations and inform their efforts to boost the efficiency of certain algorithms.

articleTitle: Medical Data Governance System using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The traditional electronic health records where there is centralized system the doctor will entry the particular patient diagnoses in the website in those case where the information with in the same organization. There is no way if person admitted in another hospital to retrieve the medical records in efficient way and fast way to access. The privacy is also one of the main issues in this way of transferring the medical information. An efficient way of storing the data in decentralized way in the blockchain is introduced, where the doctor initiates a new request to entry the patient information the blockchain creates a new block and then add to the chain which is linked to previous blocks. It is impossible to break the chain to update the information at particular block. The data is secured with asymmetric cryptography method to encrypt or decrypt the data. The doctor can upload documents for their patients, download and view documents for their patients to which they have access, and is a user in the organization with the right role. The patient can examine them, view document access logs, and manage access to their documents on their dashboard because they are an organisation user with the necessary role.

articleTitle: Detection of Face Mask using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based Real-Time Object Detection Algorithm You Only Look Once-V3 (YOLO-V3) Compared with Single-Stage Detector (SSD) Algorithm to Improve Precision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Proposed work refers to detect face masks using a CNN based on a real-time object detection algorithm in comparison to (Single Stage Detector) SSD, Yolo-V3. The Yolo-V3 algorithm is proposed and compared to the SSD algorithm. The sample size was calculated using G power (80%), and it was discovered to be 40. (i.e. For each group 20). There is a statistically significant difference of 0.000637 (p<0.5) between the two groups. The Yolo-V3 has an average accuracy of 91.28 and the SSD has an average precision value of 86.65. The Yolo-V3 algorithm has improved for preventing the spread of COVID-19 through precautionary measures.

articleTitle: Implementation of Novel Test Rank Algorithm for Effective Text Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Despite their busy schedule, people often wish to know the recent updates of what’s going on around with-in a short span of time. We are often amazed to know what could be the technology behind this technological innovation. Here comes into light Text Encapsulation. To accomplish the task of encapsulating the text into "Manually Tag Articles" or "Design an Automated System for phrase extraction". As the amount of unstructured text data in the digital world grows, automatic summarizing systems are needed that will be possible for people to quickly understand the source material. We require an extractive NLP model that is capable of doing the task on a wide scale. We use text ranking algorithm for text extraction where the number of common words measure's the similarity between two sentences. It gives the most informative document or summary which is also used to find the most relevant sentences in the text.

articleTitle: A Safety Monitoring System for Mining Workers using LORA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Today, maintaining the safety of mine workers is a major challenge. The health and lives of miners are defenceless against a few fundamental problems, such as the working environment and its long- term effects. To increase profitability and lower mining costs while also taking miner safety into account, a creative and innovative methodology is needed. A section of the proposed system is dedicated to monitoring the status of mineworkers, and a separate section is dedicated to overall monitoring. Particulate matter and gas emissions, including those of sulphur dioxide (SO2), nitrogen dioxide (NO2), carbon monoxide (CO), and others, are the main causes of air pollution in the mine worker area. To keep track of the different types of smoke levels in the mine, we are using two smoke sensors. The concentration of hazardous gases is monitored using semiconductor gas sensors. The microcontroller will buzz the user and send the information to the monitoring section via the Lora WAN module, where it will be uploaded to the webpage via IoT, if any of the smoke sensor values go above the threshold range. For long- distance networks, Lora WAN is a multi-point and media access control (MAC) protocol. It makes it possible for low-power devices to connect remotely and distantly with IoT applications. Lora WAN has a longer range and operates at lower radio frequencies. Lora WAN is a low- power wide area networking (LPWAN) protocol based on LoRa Technology. Lora WAN is important for maximizing LPWAN’s range, battery life, robustness, and affordability. There are numerous underground mining- related factors that can lead to miners falling and losing consciousness. In order to address this problem, the system sends a crisis alert via the Lora WAN module to the supervisor whenever someone falls somewhere for any reason.

articleTitle: A machine learning model develops the electrical energy consumption and costs for charging EVs through the grid
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Sustainable energy sources and efficient energy management methods are essential for carbon-neutral construction. Utilizing electric car capability is one option when sources cannot meet demand. Investment in charging facilities and electric cars is a necessary first step towards expanding vehicle-to-grid (V2G) technology, as is the acceptance that it is effective. The proprietor of an electronic car will profit financially from installing a recharge station, and the contractor will receive a reward. This report details a successful V2G approach designed and deployed on a fully functional college campus. In addition, a machine learning method has been developed to estimate future energy use and expenses for the studied structure. The created algorithm's precision in estimating energy usage ranged from 93% to 97%, with an average mistake in expense estimates of less than 7%. The findings indicate a 37% reduction in energy usage, with a possibility for savings of 68% if consistently the plan is implemented, demonstrating that the machine learning method helps lower emissions.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique to Minimising Mean Square Error in Stock Price Index Prediction Utilising Logistics Regression and LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The methodology that is recommended makes an attempt to anticipate and forecast changes in the price indices of the stock market for three specific equities that are traded on the stock market. The stock market is comprised of all of the many types of equities that are now being discussed. This paradigm makes an attempt to classify two unique types of classification algorithms, namely Long-Term Memory (LSTM) and Logistics Regression (LR). Long-Term Memory is an acronym for "Long-Term Memory," while Logistics Regression is an acronym for "LR." (LSTM). One of the criteria that is used to assess the performance of the models is the ability of both models to accurately anticipate the movement of an index that is traded on the Bombay Stock Exchange. (BSE). For the purposes of performing a study of the suggested structure for the projection of three stocks, an estimated total of thirty different participants were used. (AAPL, MSFT, and AMZN). When comparing the two models' levels of performance, it was found that the LR model (99.8%) performed substantially better than the LTSM model (72.3%) on average. This was noticed while conducting the comparison. (p0.05). When it comes to predicting stock indices by making use of the various parameters, the LR model performed noticeably better than the LTSM model.

articleTitle: Biometric Recognition System using Minutiae based Technique Comparing with Correlation Based Technique to Improve the Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Research objective is to improve the accuracy of biometric recognition systems using novel minutiae based technique compared with correlation based technique. Two groups are present in this. Group 1 is novel minutiae technique and second group is correlation based technique each having a sample size of 50. The pretest power is obtained as 80%. There are 100 samples of fingerprints which are predefined in the MATLAB data storage directory named as FVC2002. It is done using MATLAB 2017. The novel minutiae based technique is better in terms of accuracy than the correlation based technique. The false acceptance ratio of novel minutiae based technique is 0 % but the FAR of correlation based technique is 0.01 %. Therefore it is evident, the novel minutiae based technique has a greater advantage over correlation based technique. Significance value p <0.05. 0.8 is taken as G-power value. It is observed that minutiae based technique appears significantly better than the correlation based technique in terms of accuracy and FAR.

articleTitle: Measurement Framework for Machines in the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: One of the leading fields of study now is the "Web of Things" (or "WoT"). Rapid expansion has given it widespread influence in scientific and technological circles. Recently, a few obstacles, such as data interoperability and data interpretation created by "WoT" devices, have limited the spread of "IoT," However, rapid answers to these concerns encourage developers to complete their work. Thanks to recent developments in standards for dealing with these issues across enterprises, we may find answers by combining an "M2M" based design with a semantic "WoT" architecture. So far, no reliable method or solution has been developed for semantically treating "WoT" data in releasing one "M2M" standard. In order to help developers of semantic-based "WoT" apps create innovative applications without significant hurdles, the recently established "Machine to Machine" Measurement (M3) framework assists. This study proposes to combine the M3 framework with the "M2M" architecture in a streamlined fashion due to the efficiency gains and novel features of the combined frameworks. The industrial sector is revolutionising by "Machine to Machine" integration in "IOT." They are the incubators of sophisticated intelligence that will bring about unimaginable gains in efficiency and predictability.

articleTitle: Occluded Face Recognition Using Deep Convolutional Neural Network with Sparse Representation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The restricted ability to distinguish faces under occlusions is a topic that has been around for a long time and offers a unique difficulty not just for face recognition algorithms but also for humans. When compared to other obstacles, such as position variation, varied expressions, and so on, the topic involving occlusion has received significantly less attention from researchers. Despite this, occluded face identification is absolutely necessary in order to realise the full potential of face recognition for use in real-world applications. Several factors have contributed to the rapid development and improvement of facial recognition algorithms throughout the years. Researchers have researched and created a multitude of algorithms for occluded face recognition because of the unexpected aspects encountered in real-world circumstances. Yet, as a result of the epidemic, masked face recognition research has emerged as a distinct branch of occluded face identification and a pressing challenge in the field. The feature extraction stage of a convolutional neural network (CNN) is recommended to benefit from the addition of a sparse representation layer in this paper. Our objective is to improve a target network's functionality by including sparse transforms into it, all without requiring the network to perform more mathematical operations. To begin, the method that will be shown was developed by beginning with the shallow layers of a target network and then proceeding to add the sparse representation layers. Following that, the network was trained with four distinct datasets. The Difference of Gaussian Filter, also known as the DoG Filter, is a pre-processing technique that is used to minimise noise before training. The accuracy of the model that was proposed is higher than the accuracy of the other model with 98.13%.

articleTitle: IoT Based English Vocabulary Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Because of the wealth of information that can be found online, today’s students are urged to take a more active role in their education. This research draws parallels between ESP (English for Specific Purposes) instruction and the IoT environment. Our focus is on the Internet of Things (IoT), and we define it, describe its features, and answer fundamental concerns regarding its potential impact on the classroom. After examining the data, we zero in on how digital tools might improve language teachers’ methods in the classroom. We provide an instructional strategy that, by using digital tools, increased students’ interest, participation, and enthusiasm in class. The paper concludes that the importance of technology in the classroom will continue to grow, but that policymakers should take an active interest in digital technologies’ potential as pedagogical tools and collaborate closely with educators and experts/developers in the field to create new methods of teaching.

articleTitle: Accuracy Improvement of Flooded Area Detection from Satellite Images using Novel K-Nearest Neighbors in Comparison with Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: In this study, we examine the outcomes of employing Novel K-nearest Neighbors and Support Vector Machines to assess the accuracy of recognizing flooded areas. The data set that was used in this inquiry had a total of 118 samples. These samples were divided into two sets: a training set that contained 70 samples, and a testing set that contained 48 samples. An alpha value of 0.05 and a G power of 80% were used in the calculation to determine the total number of samples that were necessary for the investigation. The accuracy of the new K-nearest neighbor algorithm is 80.26 percent, whereas the accuracy of the support vector machine is 75.48%, with a significance of 0.000078 (p<0.05). The newly created K-nearest neighbor algorithm performs much better than the Support vector machine when it comes to the task of finding areas that have been flooded.

articleTitle: Detecting Singular Value Decomposition-based WatermarkEmbedded Medical Images using ResNet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Digital products copyright protection is a severe issue in the growth of network technology. The security of data, especially medical data, is of utmost importance. The growth of the internet gives easy access to transactional medical data. It causes image distortion and a high risk of misclassification among medical experts. Watermarking aims to protect information and provide authentication for data during transmission. Instead of the conventional method, the deep learning-based watermarking method gained benefits in information security. In this paper, Singular Value Decomposition transformation is applied for embedding watermark, and Resnet a deep-learning model is modified for detecting watermarked images. Watermarking algorithm ensures robust watermarking for medical images to detect changes even after some manipulations like cropping, compression, filtering rotation, and more. MSE, SSIM, and PSNR are some metrics for assessing image quality.

articleTitle: Deep Key Generation: End to End Encryption for Generic Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Steganography is the process of concealing a message's real nature by enclosing it in other information. Due to their ubiquitous use on the internet, digital photographs are the most often utilised sort of carrier document.There are various steganography techniques for hiding secret information within video frames, ranging from simple to complex, each with its own set of pros and cons. The message is concealed within the visual aspect of the frame. To increase security, this proposed system allows for specifying which bits to change rather than relying solely on LSB replacement. The sender chooses a cover image that contains the secret text or document and hides it within the image using the bit substitution method, resulting in a secure steganographic image. The image is then transmitted to the recipient through a personal or public communication network. The recipient receives the image and uses the decoder to extract the secret information

articleTitle: Multi-Key Privacy-Preserving Training and Classification using Supervised Machine Learning Techniques in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Cloud computing contains lots of processing power and storage. Cloud computing and machine learning (ML) techniques enable large-scale data processing. The enhanced ML-based categorization technique is established in the cloud. However, there is a risk of privacy leaking of training data in the data processing. The computational and communication costs of the information possessor(s) must be maintained to a minimum. This study suggests a multi-key enhanced support vector machine (MK-FHE) and multi-key fully homomorphic encryption (MK-FHE) supervised machine learning method for encrypted data (ESVM).The results suggest that MK-FHE protects data privacy and is more effective in processing.

articleTitle: Console Free Robot Chassis Using Hand Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The world is now emerging towards automation and machine-based works which brings in the need for robots. One such kind of a robot which is of a huge need in the current era is the robotic chassis which has an enormous number of usages in various domains and fields.With advancements in technology, every sector is getting benefited just like the rescue operations team becoming more compact and smaller day by day. Miniature version of robots called the robotic chassis which is used for the analysis and studying of minute places and locations are coming into action slowly which can perform live tracking while recording HD video as well. A robotic chassis is an autonomous or semi-autonomous robot that can be controlled using a controller or a console to perform various operations such as pick and place, rescue bots, analysing and studying etc, However, the most important factor has not changed much for the controller. It is still heavy and unintuitive for beginners. Using hand gesture recognition via the open cv domain, the Robotic chassis can be controlled using identical operations performed through the gestures given as the input. Using real time working model, the hand gesture controlled robotic chassis is operated wireless for the first time using a Zigbee module. Hand gesture recognition provides the desired result for the desired posture that user previously trained using Deep learning technology. The output of hand gesture recognition is given as input to the robotic chassis microcontroller to calibrate the python code to the Arduino IDE. Basic robotic operations such as Forward, Backward, Left, Right and Stop operations can be performed based on input and simultaneously the live streaming video can be telecasted.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Diagnosis of Parkinson's disease Based on Voice Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Bradykinesia, tremors, rigidity, and postural instability are symptoms of a degenerative neurological condition called Parkinson's disease (PD) affecting the motor movements. Deep brain stimulation, medication, and other therapies can all be used to treat theParkinson's disease symptoms, yet as of today, there is no effective treatment. Parkinson's disease must be recognized as early and precisely as feasible for effective disease treatment and the development of new therapies. The goal of this work is to create a model that can detect Parkinson's disease based on relevant clinical and demographic variables. It employs a number of machinelearning techniques, including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Gradient Boosting Classifier, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forest Classifier, and ensemble method, which is a voting classifier. A significant dataset that contains data on changes in speaking patterns was used to train the model. Using measures for accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, the machine learning model's performance is assessed and contrasted with that of the most widely used techniques for Parkinson's disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: Posture Similarity Index (PSI) for Ergonomics Using Joint Angle and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Ergonomics is the efficiency underlining in the subjective environment. They help in leverage sound health. It is important to maintain the correct postures for safer, healthier, and more efficient result in the subjective environment. After the evolution of virtual reality aided by Artificial Intelligence, there is high preference among users towards remote learning. Tutoring and evaluating the postures in the fields like dance or yoga remotely requires measures to indicate the correctness of the learner. The proposed model helps in identifying this measure of posture of subjected person with that of the tutors and thus helps in automating the events. This leads to effective and remote evaluation of large observations with help of Image Processing. With a performance of around 0.77 as F1 score the object detection model shows promising results followed by the object tracking and skeleton extraction.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Operational Risk Prevention and Control Monitoring of Smart Financial Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The risk of carrying on with work has expanded throughout recent years as the monetary business has developed consistently. Significant risk cases are normal, the circumstances turning out to be more convoluted, and the method for carrying out violations are tucked away among them. The pretreatment of interior and outer monetary information as well as the construction plan of intermittent NNs are the key review subjects of this work. Its goal is to foster a deep learning NN-based model for controlling monetary risk, eventually bringing down risk. The example information are first preprocessed utilizing the Fringe Destroyed calculation, the lopsidedness in the information is eliminated utilizing the oversampling approach, lastly, the example information with time series attributes are handled utilizing the long momentary memory deep NNs calculation. The end explore exhibits that, when contrasted with traditional methodologies, LSTM has a higher precision, coming to 1.9715; the example readiness technique and risk control model recommended in this study have a better capacity than recognize false customers; and the actual model has a quicker cycle productivity. The persistent control of perils coming from human exercises, interior cycles, frameworks, and outside occasions is known as operational risk the board (ORM).

articleTitle: De-raining a Single Picture Using Multi-scale Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Remove rain streaks from images using a residual attention-based multi-scale network. The pyramid design removes raindrops of various sizes while preserving the background’s coarse structure and minute details. The proposed work demonstrated that the residual between up-sampling dry and wet images can help detect moist regions. Using this residual, the de-raining network gives precedence to rain-affected locations within the pyramid structure. Each stage of the pyramid applies a reoccurring method to create a small, dependable de-raining network. This method is useful for both qualitative and quantitative evaluations. This technology eliminates rain streaks in photos, making it suitable for autonomous vehicles, security cameras, and landscape photography.

articleTitle: Application of SAR images in Iceberg Classification by using ConvNet-2
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Iceberg areas are not safe for transportation because based on climate changes icebergs are melting and not showing a dangerous way in sea areas. Based on the vision we can’t identify all the icebergs in the ocean area. So, by using a Deep learning algorithm we can classify icebergs through satellite images. In the past decades, several machine learning algorithms are implemented for classification of the images. But our aim is to implement an application to classify the iceberg by using synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) images which are available at the Kaggle repository. The Data set was from the Statoil C-CORE East Coast of Canada. Here we classify the icebergs by using remotely sensed data. For this data, the Convolutional Neural Network is used for image classification and extraction of the features of images deeply. The CNN algorithm was implemented on the SAR images and achieved 99.8% training and 89.5% of validation accuracy with high time consumption when training the dataset.

articleTitle: Attention-based model for smart EEG Categorization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Deep learning advancements are focusing on attentional mechanisms for graph analysis to pinpoint the crucial elements for improved decision-making. By using attentional mechanisms, the network can improve the accuracy of the classification task by focusing on the most important parts of the input signals. Functional connectivity of the human brain is a complex field requiring expert clinical knowledge due to the swift alterations in bodily functions, anomalies, and significant differences between individuals often present in EEG signals. These factors make it challenging to accurately classify EEG signals as normal or abnormal. However, the classification task can be made more manageable by using brain network representation of EEG signals. Brain network representation allows for the creation of a graph-based model of the functional connectivity of the human brain, which can be used to recognize important patterns and features in the EEG signals that are relevant to specific brain activities or conditions. The aim is to assess the efficacy of attentional mechanisms in a crucial scenario by examining the brain network representation of EEG signals recorded during a task that involves distinguishing between normal and abnormal EEG patterns.

articleTitle: Automatic Fertilized Vertical Irrigation Control and Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Destiny agricultural generation, known as "agriculture four.0," is product of a number of important allowing technologies. Agriculture is an essential issue of every country’s development, and it frequently requires the right quantity of fertilization, irrigation, and seasoning to provide an enough quantity of food goods. Fertilization systems have demonstrated effective in promoting plant increase, development, and large-yield crop manufacturing. The reason of this undertaking is to layout an automatic fertilized vertical irrigation management and control system for the improvement of soil vitamins and porosity via the timely application of fertilizer and water tiers needed to sell plant improvement. This automatic vertical farming system using sensors effectively assesses the requirements of plants and it detects the moisture content material and fertilizer content material in the soil. Thus the plants are provided with the required minerals and water so as to get greater yield together with reduction in time and cost.

articleTitle: A Secure and Efficient Blockchain-based Multi-Cloud Medical File Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The blockchain-powered scheme for sharing medical files in a practical manner decentralized quality-based encryption is a secure and efficient approach for sharing sensitive medical information among healthcare providers. The system utilizes blockchain technology to store and handle the framework for restricting entry to specific areas and permissions for medical files, providing a tamper-proof and transparent mechanism for managing access to the data. Additionally, the use of decentralized attributes- based encryption ensures that patient data remains confidential and only accessible to those with the appropriate permissions. The scheme enables data owners to define granular access control policies based on specific attributes such as the type of data, patient information, and the role of the requesting party, enabling better collaboration and decision-making while ensuring data privacy and confidentiality.

articleTitle: Design, Analysis and Implementation of Microstrip UWB Antenna to monitor the Fetus in Uterus
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: With the growth of the healthcare and biomedical industries, biomedical telemetry antenna has attracted a lot of interest. With the help of conventional hospital visits and follow-up routine check-ups, it is now possible to remotely monitor a patient's physiological indications. This is made possible by the Use of integrated Hilbert curve expandable antenna technology. The integrated Hilbert curve expandable biomedical antenna devices (IHEBAD) that have been proposed play a significant part in the monitoring of the fetus found in the patient using wireless telemetry such as an ISM (2.45 GHz) and UWB (4.25 GHz) band. For the extendable antenna, a number of elements need to be taken into account, including miniaturization, patient safety, biocompatibility, low power consumption, reduced frequency band of operation, and dual band specifications. Choosing an antenna is a difficult task for Hilbert to design. This paper presents the key finding in the integrated Hilbert curve expandable biomedical antenna proposal with wearable substrate. To confirm the use of the suggested antenna design, the proposed antenna's essential characteristics are analyzed. They also demonstrate a good level of simulation agreement.

articleTitle: Deep convolutional neural networks and transfer learning for classifying malignant and benign skin cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Over 123,000 occurrences of skin cancer cases are identified globally each year. The ability to identify malignant skin lesions as early as possible would be a huge benefit to clinicians from reliable automatic skin cancer screening systems. In the last five years, it appears that methods based on deep learning perform better than conventional methods for classifying images. Techniques based on machine learning are less practical because they need thousands of labelled images for each class to be trained. We propose a precise method to distinguish benign from malignant skin lesions using deep convolutional neural networks with transfer learning (DCNNT). The first step in our process is to eliminate noise and artefacts from the input images. In the second step, the input images must be normalized and features needed for classification extracted. The third is to augment the data with additional images, which improves classification accuracy. We employ transfer learning models, such as Densenet121, MobileNet, ResNet50, and VGG19 to assess the performance of our suggested DCNNT model. On a dataset comparing benign and malignant tumours, we obtained the highest training and testing accuracy with DCNN and DenseNet transfer learning model, with 98.16% training and 92.42% testing. Our DCNNT model is dependable and robust. We discovered that our suggested model performed better than other model.

articleTitle: An Image-Processing-Based System for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Understanding how to recognize and track a moving object in real time is essential in the field of computer vision. Underwater computer vision can collect important data that might be used in a wide variety of practical applications. This concept is employed for surveillance, allowing us to keep tabs on the military installation, manage traffic, and coordinate with submerged devices to save lives. The robot’s position will be adjusted to the left, right, front, and rear depending on where the item is detected and identified to be moving in this project. Hardware-wise, we're using an Arm11 Raspberry Pi, a picamera for Arduino mounting, and an Android device for tracking the robot’s movements. articleTitle: The Application of Machine Learning to the Task of Poverty Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: For many societal and economic issues, poverty has become a stubborn underlying cause. The high rate of reproduction is a contributing factor to India's poverty. The government must implement a small number of effective programmes if poverty is to be reduced. Most of the time, a survey is conducted prior to the creation of policies, and only direct factors like income or consumption levels are considered. However, direct measures alone are insufficient for classifying households into poverty brackets. Therefore, we divide the poor into categories according to factors such as education, number of people in the home, housing conditions, and many more. (i) we extract a subset of features that are critical for identifying poverty; (ii)We investigate the effects of the extracted features on the category; and (iii)To choose the most reliable machine learning model, we utilize numerous models and evaluate their results. Instead of utilizing the traditional one-dimensional lens to study poverty levels, we employ the "Proxy Means Test" ("PMT") to look at different levels of poverty in a broader context.

articleTitle: Application of Regression Analysis to Find Association between Women Entrepreneurship and Sustainable Development Goals
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The significance of women’s entrepreneurship in SDG attainment has emerged as a critical topic for attaining long-term development. This study aims to experimentally demonstrate the link between Sustainability and women’s entrepreneurship. In this study, we have focused on "Goal 1 (No poverty), Goal 2 (Zero hunger), Goal 3 (Good Health and well-being), Goal 4 (Quality education), Goal 5 (Gender equality), and Goal 6 (Clean water and Sanitation)". Secondary data sources are used to collect data from forty-two countries across the globe. Data on SDG targets is gathered from Cambridge University’s Sustainable Development Report 2021, while data on women’s entrepreneurship is collected from the GEM (Global Entrepreneurship Measure) database. The Pearson correlation and linear regression analyses determine the association between women’s entrepreneurship and specific SDG targets. Women’s entrepreneurship has been found to affect children’s nutrition, pregnancy, and infant mortality rates, unnatural death rates, life expectancy at birth, enrolment in primary education, secondary completion rate, drinking and Sanitation, and life expectancy at age one.

articleTitle: Automated Germinationrate and Quality Evaluation of Rice Seedsusing Computer Vision and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Good seed germination with high quality is critical for rice seed quality and production, which affects rice output and crop yield. Currently, paddy germination and quality evaluation are done manually by qualified individuals. Images of germinated rice seed are being captured on a daily basis. In this paper, we present a method for automatically evaluating the germination rate and quality of rice seeds that is based on sophisticated computer vision and machine learning algorithms. For rice seed detection, segmented areas will be subjected to processing such as calculating distance transform and thresholding.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning to Analyze Twitter’s Sentiment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: This paper revolved around sentiment analysis from tweets and methods used for it. Negative and positive emotions, as well as other elements like as emoticons, quotations, hashtags, mentions, etc., may all be retrieved in this way. In order to improve efficiency and make the transformation from words to vectors possible, the Word2Vec Model is used. Random Forest and Naive Bayes are two examples of machine learning algorithms that make use of Bag of Words. The last step is to use the XGBoost model with its improved parameters to determine the best classification strategy for Sentiment Analysis.

articleTitle: Building a Secure and High-Performance HMAC Processor Based on SHA-3 for the Cloud-Based Financial Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: A cloud-based financial environment can provide cost savings, scalability, security, and accessibility benefits to financial organizations, making it an attractive option for financial operations. Several issues relate to the authenticity and integrity of messages in a cloud-based financial environment, like "man in the middle" attacks, data tampering, data loss, and data breaches. To address these issues, it is important to implement security measures such as HMAC-SHA3 to ensure the authenticity and integrity of messages in a cloud-based financial environment. It uses one of the SHA-3 hash functions, such as SHA3-256 or SHA3-512, to calculate the HMAC value for a message. The HMAC result is next added to a message and delivered to the receiver. The recipient then determines the HMAC score for the communication utilizing the same private key and compares it with the HMAC values assigned to the message in order to confirm the message's authenticity. If the values match, it means that the message has not been tampered with and is authentic. If the values do not match, it means that the message has been tampered with or is not authentic, and the recipient should discard the message. HMAC-SHA3 is a secure cryptographic method that is used to ensure the authenticity and integrity of messages in a cloud-based financial environment, helping to protect against attacks such as man-in-the-middle attacks where a malicious actor could intercept and tamper with financial messages being transmitted between two parties. The result shows that HMAC-SHA3 is better in terms of throughput and efficiency compared to the MAC algorithm, making it a more effective method of solving many real-time security issues in cloud-based applications.

articleTitle: Labview Based Various Sensors Data Acquisition System for Smart City Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: This research demonstrates a novel method for managing low-cost industrial processes using the real-time Lab-VIEW platform. The data flow language G is the foundation of the graphical programming environment LabVIEW. This strategy benefits us since the setting encourages a fairly consistent evolution from concept to implementation, enabling effective co-simulation techniques. The system has the ability to recognize an object and regulate its movement in the industry. The hardware is tightly integrated via a data acquisition (DAQ) device. Furthermore, LabVIEW’s graphical programming language makes it simple to integrate many other types of sensors, and by doing so, we can quickly access and manipulate the sensor signals.

articleTitle: Diagnostic Test classification of cervical cancer abnormalities using Bagging Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Regardless of the illness, a patient has a higher chance of recovery if the illness is caught early rather than later. One such illness is cervical cancer, which ranks number four on the list of the most prevalent cancers among females worldwide. Age and the use of hormonal contraceptives are only two of the numerous risk factors that might lead to cervical cancer. Cervical cancer survival rates can be improved and mortality rates reduced with early identification. The goal of this work is to use machine learning methods towards the creation of a model that can detect cervical cancer with a high degree of specificity and accuracy. articleTitle: Human Resource Management in the Power Industry Using Fuzzy Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)

articleTitle: LiFi: A Visible Light Communication Assisted Fishermen Tracking System using GPS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The lack of a clear maritime border between the countries is a major contributor to the brutality that occurs across international boundaries. A pre-programmed warning system that would advise fisherman when they are about to breach the line and avert an emergency is something that social activists have been calling for. The following debate centers on the potential development of a warning system that may routinely intimate the fisherman as they approach the sea boundary. The costs associated with implementing GPS will be high. Using a Li-Fi network designed to deliver signals to the boat will be more efficient than relying on GPS to track location. The term "Li-Fi" refers to a type of wireless optical communication that uses visible light and is both fast and completely networked. Using the suggested approach, a light signal may be sent from a sensor installed in a ship's workplace to the cabin of the officer in charge of that area. There is a gas sensor to detect the presence of poisonous gases, a fire sensor to signal the existence of a fire, and a water leakage sensor to signal the presence of water leaks in the ship. The information gleaned from the sensors is converted into sound before being relayed through Li-Fi to the receiver. The relevance of the correspondence has increased as a way of transmitting data and information over long distances using light force and Visible Light Communication (VLC). The components of this system collaborate to keep a watchful eye on the waterways at all times. Ready fishermen will get a dependable reaction before they inadvertently go overboard.

articleTitle: Receiver-Based Data Communication for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: As the Web of Things (IoT) has created throughout recent years, unlicensed radio range has become more clogged with brilliant wireless gadgets that are utilized in an assortment of use spaces, prominently the 2.4 GHz ISM band. articleTitle: An Intelligent Light Assisted Wireless Vehicle Communications using Visible Light Communication

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of IRIS based Human Identity recognition using various Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The module responsible for user safety is one of the most vital components of computer systems. articleTitle: Unleashing the Power of Machine and Deep Learning for Advanced Network Intrusion Detection: An Analysis and Exploration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The rapidly growing advance and complex internet and communication area result into a big network and data. articleTitle: A Novel Machine Learning Unmanned Swarm Intelligence Based Data Security in Defence System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)

articleTitle: Lung Disease Detection using Deep Learning

articleTitle: Machine learning based human interacted robotic intelligence to detect the different categories of speech
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Realizing artificial intelligence depends heavily on human-robot interaction (HRI) technology. Here, we present dual-function sound actuators built on graphene for human-robot exchanges that use machine learning. (GHRI). The GHRI's triboelectric acoustic detection mechanism and thermoacoustic sound output mechanism allow it to serve as both a prosthetic ear and tongue. Triboelectric materials, electrodes, and thermoacoustic sources made possible by laser-induced graphene contributed to the overall success of the combined device. The GHRI can recognize speech identities, feelings, substance, and other information in the human speech by optimizing the structure parameters to produce high sensitivity and working longevity. With the help of machine learning, a convolutional neural network is used to teach 30 voice categories, with an accuracy of 99.72% and 97.83% in training and test datasets, respectively. In addition, AIs can use GHRI to communicate through recognized voice characteristics. The implications of our research for the future of artificial intelligence in robots are vast.

articleTitle: An IoT Assisted Weather Prediction and Information Monitoring Scheme based on Intensive Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Several of the environmental characteristics we hold dear, including our fundamental ecology, regional climatic variances, and global variety, are threatened caused by widespread industry and increasing urbanization. Problems arise in our everyday lives as a consequence of the challenges we face due of the rapid pace at which things are changing. These problems have their origins in the rapid pace of digitalization and the lack of enough infrastructure for handling and analyzing extremely large data sets. When data generated by the IoT detection layer is inaccurate, partial, or irrelevant, it affects weather forecast reports, which in turn disrupts activities that rely on precise and reliable weather predictions. Some of the main problems in the modern world is getting accurate readings of the surroundings in real time, as doing so presents a number of obstacles. The proposed technology could avoid such events from occurring by constantly monitoring the weather. The suggested solution is built on the cutting edge of embedded system technology and the IoT. Electronic components, sensor nodes, and wireless infrastructure are also part of the system. The primary function of the sensors in this framework is to monitor environmental factors such as temperature, humidity, and gas concentrations. Data collected in this way can be transmitted to external systems, such as databases. Random Forest, Logistic Regression, AdaBoost, and Naive Bayes were all used to compare their respective identification of anomalies scores. These algorithms were applied to the time-based, temperature-based, pressure-based, and humidity-based data produced by the sensors.

articleTitle: Retail Business Convenience Segmentation using Clustering and Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The conventional approach to launching a business is to research and gather data regarding the past performance of rival businesses unless they were profitable or unsuccessful. Innovation is the ethos of the modern day, as everyone is engaged in a struggle to outperform one another. Data will be segmented using clustering algorithms, allowing for much more focused production of the final result.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Detecting and Predicting Emerging Disease in Poultry Chickens Based on MobileNet Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The chicken business has a significant impact on the food manufacturing sector. Concerns over poultry birds’ quality have increased globally as demand has risen. Chicken eggs and chicken meat are both helped along by the industry’s commitment to quality control. The industry’s players are worried about the welfare of the birds because of the rising demand for poultry meat. The poultry sector is able to keep better tabs on the well-being of its chickens thanks to recent technology breakthroughs. With the use of Internet of Things (IoT)-based wearable sensing devices like accelerometers and gyro devices, avian diseases and chicken health may now be diagnosed via video surveillance, voice observations, and feces inspections. Placed atop a chicken, these motion detectors send the hen’s daily movements to the internet for examination. It’s a difficult problem to analyze such data and provide more precise forecasts regarding chicken health. In this research, we present a framework for an Internet of Things-based prediction service that can identify illnesses in chicken flocks at an early stage. The MobileNet approach has been shown to reach a 97% accuracy in both theoretical analysis and experimental findings. In addition, the suggested research compares the efficacy of several classification models to provide a more precise and top-performing classification strategy. The primary goal of the research is to provide predictive service architecture based on Industrial IoT that can more precisely categorize poultry hens in real time.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Assisted Road Traffic and Safety Monitoring Scheme using Sensitive Alcohol Detectors with Speed Analyzing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The term "Internet of Things" refers to a network of interconnected, distinctive gadgets. In the IoT, there is a vast variety of functions that a single device may serve. This study proposes a paradigm based on the Internet of Things to prevent intoxicated and sleepy driving, particularly at night. In this study, we use IoT technology to create an alcohol screening device for safer road mobility in a smart city. Limits for the amount of alcohol in one's blood are programmed and tracked with the help of a microcontroller. When the predetermined limit is achieved, the system sends the driver's blood alcohol concentration and the GPS coordinates of the car to a central monitoring unit. These models will aid in reducing drunk driving and keeping people safe on the road. Safer roads and fewer accidents are possible thanks to increased surveillance. The testing outcomes demonstrate the system's low cost, usefulness, precision, and dependability.

articleTitle: Smart RFID: Experimental Evaluation of Secured Students Attendance Handling System Using RFID
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: While old techniques are time-consuming and inefficient, recent years have seen a rise in the importance of student attendance as a reflection of academic accomplishments and the effectiveness provided to any university. Recently, however, a variety of automated identifying technologies, such as Radio Frequency Identification (RFID), have gained popularity (RFID). Many studies and applications being developed to make the most of this technology, which raises certain ethical questions. RFID, or radio-frequency identification, is a wireless technology used for the purpose of identifying and monitoring an object by the transfer of data from an electronic tag, termed an RFID tag or label, via radio waves to an RFID reader. In this project, an RFID-based system has been developed to provide an attendance monitoring system. In addition to streamlining the process as a whole, automated attendance management software will also produce a well-structured and analyzed report of the pattern of student attendance and time management, which may aid in the allocation and use of human resources. In this study, RFID was used to the task of tracking student attendance, allowing teachers and administrators to more efficiently record in-person classroom statistics that may be used to determine how students should be graded and inform other administrative choices.

articleTitle: Identification of Persisting Trend in the Indian Stock Markets Using AI
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: Utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) techniques, this study aims to solve the issue of a forecast of the stock market. The findings from both the technical and fundamental analyses may inform one of two potential stock market forecasting models. Specialized examination use relapse machine learning (ML) calculations to estimate the heading of a stock's cost at the end of exchanging in light of verifiable cost information. Conversely, ML calculations trained on news and web-based entertainment is utilized to arrange popular assessment in the principal examination. While principal investigation brings a look into Twitter gab about the stock market to decide the effect of financial backer feeling on cost projections, technical analysis relies on Yahoo Finance's historical price data. The findings indicate a median performance, indicating that it is premature to assert that AI can outperform stock markets given present AI capabilities.

articleTitle: A Novel Metaheuristic Algorithm Optimized Deep CNN-LSTM Model for Amla Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The quality evaluation of agricultural goods are vital components in improving their vendibility and managing wastes. Fruit diseases present a persistent risk to producers and consumers. Precision agriculture can assist in making decisions on the management of fruit diseases by using computer vision-based approaches. Manual disease detection is highly challenging and it takes an excessive amount of effort, knowledge, and processing time. Deep learning is therefore used to better accurately diagnose diseases. In this work, it is aimed to present deep learning framework approach for quickly identifying the apparent defects in amla fruit. In the proposed algorithm, deep convolutional neural network model with marine predator optimization algorithm is used for optimizing the accuracy of disease detection in amla fruit. The structure of the deep convolutional neural network comprises components for feature extraction and optimum classification. The hyperparameters for training convolutional neural network layers are tuned by marine predator optimization algorithm. The efficiency of proposed model is evaluated and compared to other optimization strategies. The optimized deep learning model outperforms by providing greater classification accuracy when compared to the current approaches, according to numerical analysis, demonstrating its potential for accurate disease detection and classification.

articleTitle: Accuracy Enhancement of Real-Time Novel Water Quality Monitoring System using Arduino in Comparison with Microcontroller based System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The fundamental objective of this study is to develop and implement a system based on Arduino Uno that is capable of monitoring the quality of the water. The first part involves monitoring a patient's health status with sensors; the second part involves uploading that information to a cloud service; and the third part involves providing access to that information from a remote location. Because the information can be accessed remotely, a doctor or guardian can keep tabs on a patient's health even when they are not physically present at the facility. The transition from traditional medical consultation to more convenient and cost-effective telemedicine has been made easier by IoT developments. All of a patient's vital signs, such as temperature, heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, and EKG signals, are constantly monitored by the proposed device and sent to a related hybrid cloud server every 10 seconds for the attending doctor to look at. In the event of an emergency, the system will send out alerts via Telegram message utilising GSM technology and trigger an alarm system. It allows medical professionals, family members, and friends of patients, wherever they are in the world, to keep tabs on vital signs in real time. A total of 15 individuals were included in the study, all of whom had positive outcomes. This paper's proposed system reveals a future vision of biomedical engineering: a patient-and doctor-controlled, highly responsive, and interactive intensive care unit.

articleTitle: An Effective Security Protocol Design for IRIS based Credential Evaluation using Intensive Deep Learning Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The component of a system charged with ensuring the security of its users is among its most crucial parts. It has been demonstrated that using a password or login that is too basic makes you vulnerable to hackers and does not ensure a high level of security. Authentication using biometric methods can be achieved in several ways. Some of the most advanced and reliable are facial recognition technology and iris recognition. Because it relies heavily on detection of patterns, it is able to reliably identify the rightful owner of an Iris scan. Accuracy as well as effectiveness have both been greatly enhanced in the resultant recognition system. Security breaches and other identification scams are on the rise, making it all the more crucial to implement a robust biometric system. The option that has gained a lot of attention is biometric identification. The iris's potential as a biometric has gained traction in recent years. This quantifiable quality ensures great productivity and precision, which is what triggered the phenomenon. We present a complete ResNet50-based deep learning system for iris identification in this study. Utilizing only a small number of training photos from every class, we train our algorithm on a popular identification of iris dataset, achieving significant gains over prior methods. In addition, we introduce a visualization method that may identify key features of iris pictures that have a significant bearing on the precision of recognition. We anticipate that this approach will be utilized extensively in the future to improve the scalability and precision of various biometrics identification jobs

articleTitle: A Biometric Vehicle Theft Identification and Prevention Scheme using GPS Location Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication and Applied Informatics (ACCAI)
abstract: The demand for security is rising in every sector of society as the pace of technological development and scientific discovery quickens. Right now, having access to a car is essential. At the same time, preventing theft from happening is crucial. The expense and complexity of conventional methods of protecting vehicles are substantial. There is no further action or option that might help the car's owner recover their vehicle once it has been stolen. The usage of biometrics such as fingerprints is widespread and is now routine in many settings, including businesses, public buildings, educational institutions, and more. The primary objective of this study is to secure the car against unwanted entry using fingerprint recognition technology that is both quick and simple to implement, as well as clear, reliable, and cost-effective. A method was necessary to track where each vehicle was at all times and how far it had gone. These days, active vehicle monitoring and GPS technologies are used to keep tabs on our motor vehicles. Images of fingerprints are taken by the sensor, and the sensor then compares each fingerprint it reads to a database of recorded fingerprints or to a module inside the system.
